final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), s2 AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_amt) AS avg2 FROM s1 GROUP BY frequency) SELECT s1.account_id, s1.frequency, s1.avg_amt, s1.avg_amt * 1.0 / NULLIF(s2.avg2, 0) AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.frequency = s2.frequency ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
